description: This file defines the class SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport, which provides generic JPA data access operations such as CRUD, query building, filtering, counting, and sorting. It acts as a support class for DAOs interacting with a database through JPA in a Spring framework environment.

classes.name: SalesManagerJpaDaoSupport
classes.description: A generic JPA DAO support class providing common database operations, query building and filtering functions, intended to be extended by specific DAO implementations.

methods.name: buildTypedQuery
methods.description: Creates a TypedQuery from criteria, applying optional limit and offset for pagination.

methods.name: filterCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Applies a filter expression to a criteria query if it's not null.

methods.name: rootCriteriaQuery
methods.description: Creates a root for criteria query for the specified entity class.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its class and identifier.

methods.name: getByField
methods.description: Retrieves a single entity matching a specific field value.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merges an entity into the persistence context if it's detached.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes entity state from the database.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes persistence context changes to the database.

methods.name: listEntity
methods.description: Returns a list of entities based on optional filtering, ordering, limit, and offset.

methods.name: listEntityByField
methods.description: Retrieves entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: countEntity
methods.description: Returns the total count of entities of a class.

methods.name: countEntityByField
methods.description: Returns the count of entities matching a specific field value.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Returns a single result or null if no result is found, for criteria or typed query.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Sorts a list of entities in-place using their natural ordering.
